title: Conversation Is a Two-Body Problem: Dyadic Evaluation of Full-Duplex Dialogue Models
title_zh: 对话是一个双体问题：全双工对话模型的二元评测
abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models listen and speak at the same time, enabling voice agents to have natural, low-latency interactions that turn-based systems cannot offer. However, they are commonly evaluated against single-sided interlocutors: pre-recorded audio that cannot react, or an automated examiner that reacts in real time but only administers a fixed sequence of tests and is never graded. These single-sided frameworks evaluate only half of a two-body problem, where turn-taking, overlap, and interruption are joint products of two coupled speakers. We propose DyaFDB, a framework that evaluates full-duplex models in a dyadic setup: two models converse directly under assigned roles with cooperative or conflicting goals, and both sides are scored offline with an external judge. DyaFDB probes how the two models behave toward each other, such as how they take turns or carry an assigned role under different interests. We instantiate four tasks as 140 scenarios and record 7,560 conversations, covering six self- and cross-play pairings. Throughout the experiments, we observe that how a model behaves continually reshapes its partner. We thus demonstrate that each model must be both the examiner and examinee of the other, and no single fixed interlocutor can play both parts. We will release the scenarios, role prompts, and recording protocols between two full-duplex models, without any pre-recorded audio.
abstract_zh: 全双工语音对话模型能够同时听与说，实现低延迟、自然的语音交互。然而，现有评测通常仅使用无法反应的预录音，或仅执行固定测试流程且不被评分的自动考官，因此只评估了双体交互的一方。本文提出 DyaFDB，一种面向二元交互的全双工模型评测框架：让两个模型在分配的角色下直接对话，并设置合作或冲突目标；随后由外部评审器离线评价双方表现。DyaFDB考察模型如何相互影响，包括轮流发言、重叠、打断以及在不同利益下履行角色等行为。作者设计了4项任务、140个场景，采集7,560段对话，覆盖6种自博弈与交叉博弈组合。实验表明，模型的行为会持续重塑其对话伙伴，因此每个模型既应作为对方的考官，也应作为被考察者；不存在一个固定的单侧交互者能够同时承担这两种角色。作者将发布场景、角色提示词及两个全双工模型之间的录音协议，且不依赖预录音。
key_points_zh: 现有单侧评测忽略了轮流、重叠和打断等由双方共同产生的交互行为。
DyaFDB让两个全双工模型在合作或冲突角色下直接对话，并由外部评审器同时评分双方。
评测包含4项任务、140个场景和7,560段对话，覆盖6种自博弈与交叉博弈组合。
实验发现，模型行为会持续改变对话伙伴；因此双方都应互为考官与被考察者。
作者计划开源场景、角色提示词和双模型录音协议，避免依赖预录制音频。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant dyadic evaluation framework that measures full-duplex voice agents as mutually coupled interlocutors and releases reusable scenarios and protocols.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作提出面向全双工语音智能体的双边评测框架，并提供可复用的场景与协议，领域相关性和长期价值都很高。
